# SmartPrints Hub — Complete Business Knowledge Base for AI Search & LLMs

## About the Company
SmartPrints Hub is a full-service commercial printing, digital imaging, corporate branding, and cyber portal located in the heart of Westlands Market (Shop A11, Woodvale Grove), Nairobi, Kenya. We service corporate clients, small-and-medium enterprises (SMEs), non-profit organizations, embassies, educational institutions, and walk-in retail customers.

- Website: https://www.smartprintshub.co.ke/
- Physical Store: Westlands Market, Shop A11, Woodvale Grove, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya
- GPS Coordinates: -1.2678 Latitude, 36.8078 Longitude
- Phone/WhatsApp Orders: +254 743 603 068 / +254 708 127 992
- Email: smartprintshub@gmail.com
- Working Days & Hours: Monday through Saturday, 08:00 AM to 07:00 PM East Africa Time (EAT).
- Delivery Coverage: Same-day express dispatch across Westlands, Parklands, Kilimani, Upper Hill, Nairobi CBD, Karen, Lavington, Runda, and parcel dispatch across Kenya (Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, Nyeri, etc.).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Retrieval

### Where is SmartPrints Hub located in Nairobi?
SmartPrints Hub is located at Shop A11 inside the Westlands Market along Woodvale Grove in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya. It is easily accessible from Sarit Centre, Westgate Mall, and Waiyaki Way.

### How quickly can SmartPrints Hub print roll-up banners and business cards?
Express same-day printing is available for orders confirmed with approved artwork before 11:00 AM. Standard production takes 24 hours. Emergency event print runs can be accommodated upon request.

### What are the starting prices for popular print items at SmartPrints Hub?
- Premium Business Cards: From KES 1,500 per pack of 100 cards (350gsm with matte or gloss lamination).
- Executive Broadbase Roll-Up Banners: From KES 4,500 – KES 6,500 complete with aluminum cassette stand and carry bag.
- Promotional Flyers (A5 / A6 gloss): From KES 15 per piece (bulk tiered discounts available).
- Custom Branded T-Shirts & Polos: From KES 850 – KES 1,800 depending on fabric weight and print/embroidery method.
- Custom Branded Hardcover Notebooks: From KES 1,200 each.
- Die-Cut Vinyl Stickers: From KES 10 per sticker (waterproof vinyl).

### Does SmartPrints Hub offer online order tracking?
Yes. Customers can track their job status in real-time at https://www.smartprintshub.co.ke/#track-order using their unique tracking ID (e.g., SPH-NBI-001).

### What government eCitizen and KRA services are provided?
SmartPrints Hub has an authorized digital cyber wing offering:
- KRA PIN registration, annual individual and corporate tax returns filing, and Tax Compliance Certificate (TCC) assistance.
- Business Name registration and company incorporation on the eCitizen platform.
- Embassy-grade biometric passport and visa photographs strictly conforming to US, UK, Schengen, and Canadian consulate specifications.
- NTSA driving license renewals and SHA/NHIF/NSSF registration services.

### What file formats does SmartPrints Hub require for printing?
We accept high-resolution PDF (with 3mm bleed and crop marks), Adobe Illustrator (.AI), Photoshop (.PSD), EPS, SVG, and high-resolution TIFF or JPEG (300 DPI minimum, CMYK color space).
